name: word_drawings
description: Drawings: list; insert a picture from an image blob (width keeps the aspect ratio), a text box or a shape, inline or floating; move, resize, float or inline, set wrapping and order.

image.description: insert_picture: image blob handle, e.g. b2.

at.description: insert_*: position, or after:/before: a block (a paragraph of its own).

find.description: insert_*: text occurring once to anchor after.

align.description: float, insert_*: across, instead of x; own paragraph: its alignment.

against.description: What x and align measure from. Default column.

wrap.description: float, set, insert_*: text wrapping; inserts float with it.

alt_text.description: insert_picture (needed), set: text for screen readers.

color.description: insert_picture: tint an SVG, theme colour or RRGGBB.

key.description: Retry key: a repeat with the same key makes nothing new.
